h1: Custom Rainbow Tank Tops for Pride & Events
metaTitle: Custom Rainbow Tank Tops | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom rainbow tank tops for Pride parades, team events & giveaways. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rainbow tank tops make a bold statement for Pride events, diversity celebrations, and team-building activities. Unlike standard solid-color tank tops, the rainbow colorway instantly signals inclusivity and energy. These are popular for corporate parades, charity runs, and summer festivals where you want your group to stand out. Screen printing or heat transfer works well on the broad front panel, and customizing with your logo or message turns a simple tank into a walking billboard for your brand.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom rainbow tank tops with printed logos at a Pride parade
